$comment: Recipes for every screenshot and loop the docs own. Each entry is captured from the running site by scripts/capture-doc-media.mjs and lands in public/docs/img/<id>.webp with provenance in public/docs/media-manifest.json. Edit the recipe, re-run the script; never hand-place a file the docs reference.
